name: Plastics and injection moulding

problems.words: Resin price changes every week and my price list is fixed for dealers
quick_ideas: Work out cost per piece for your top items at today's resin rate, so you see which are now underpriced
Compare it with your current dealer price list

workzap_build.text: A cost per piece calculator using resin rate, part weight, cycle time, power and rejects, feeding a dealer price list that updates with resin rates.

problems.ask_first: How often do you update your rate list now?
problems.free_stops: How the cost is built and how the price list is updated is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note today's resin rate beside your dealer price for your fastest items, so underpriced pieces are easy to spot.
Give one person the job of updating one paper dealer price list each week, so quotes follow current resin changes.

problems.words: Traders delay resin deliveries and the machines stand idle
quick_ideas: Count resin and masterbatch stock once and match it against this week's jobs, so you see shortages coming
Agree a minimum level for each grade with the store keeper

workzap_build.text: Resin and masterbatch stock with consumption per job and reorder alerts before machines stop.

problems.ask_first: Do deliveries run late from most traders, or mainly from one?
problems.free_stops: How consumption and minimum levels are calculated is covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each machine stoppage caused by delayed resin and the missing grade, so the worst supply gaps stand out.
Give one store person one notebook for incoming resin promises and actual arrivals, so late traders are easier to challenge.

problems.words: Mould broke and the repair shop takes weeks
quick_ideas: List every active mould with owner, location and condition, so you know which are at risk
Note which moulds broke last, so they are checked first

workzap_build.text: A mould register with owner, location, cavities, standard cycle time and repair history, plus a preventive maintenance calendar.

problems.ask_first: Are the broken moulds mostly old ones, or newly made ones?
problems.free_stops: Inspection routine and maintenance schedule are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many active jobs depend on each mould now out for repair, so the real production hold-up is clear.
Give one person one notebook for mould movement, repair dates and return dates, so follow-up with the repair shop stays regular.

problems.words: Reject rate on some moulds is high
quick_ideas: Count rejects per mould for one week, so the worst ones show up
Note the most common defect on each

workzap_build.text: A machine-wise shift log of shots, rejects and downtime reasons, with a daily view per machine and shift.

problems.ask_first: Are high rejects on a few moulds, or on most of them?
problems.free_stops: How rejects are recorded and compared is kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare reject trays across moulds at the end of each shift, so the worst moulds for waste stand out quickly.
Give one supervisor one board to record rejects by mould each shift, so rework gets tracked the same way every time.

problems.words: Production per shift is written by operators, numbers look made up
quick_ideas: Check the shot counter on a few machines at shift change against the written figure, so you see if there is a gap
Have the shift supervisor sign the shift sheet

workzap_build.text: A shift log on phone where the supervisor records counter readings, pieces, rejects and downtime openly each shift.

problems.ask_first: Do the made-up looking numbers show on every shift, or on certain ones?
problems.free_stops: How readings are captured and checked is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare packed goods with the written shift output on a few machines, so the recording gap shows.
Give one supervisor the handover job for checking written output at each shift end, so reported production stops changing unchecked.

problems.words: Regrind and scrap bags go missing
quick_ideas: Weigh this week's regrind and scrap before it leaves the floor, so you have a real figure
Store bags in one locked area

workzap_build.text: A regrind and scrap weighing log with gate pass matching.

problems.ask_first: Do the bags go missing from the floor, or from the store?
problems.free_stops: Weighing points and matching are covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count scrap and regrind bags leaving the floor each day and note where they went, so missing material patterns stand out.
Give one store person one place to record every scrap bag handover, so bags stop moving without a trace.

problems.words: Finished goods pile up in some items, out of stock in others
quick_ideas: Count finished stock by item and colour once
Compare it with dealer orders from the last month

workzap_build.text: Finished goods stock by item and colour with dealer order matching and a daily read of what is short.

problems.ask_first: Do piles build up in certain colours, or in certain items?
problems.free_stops: How stock is matched to orders is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the finished goods area and note items with the highest piles beside recent dealer requests, so mismatches stand out clearly.
Give one person the job of updating one stock notebook after each dispatch, so fast-moving items are less likely to run out.

problems.words: Dealers get credit and payment is slow
quick_ideas: List every dealer's balance and oldest bill
Check that list before the next dispatch

workzap_build.text: A dealer ledger with credit limits and payment reminders.

problems.ask_first: Is slow payment from a few dealers, or from most of them?
problems.free_stops: Limits and reminder timing are kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many dealer balances have no promised follow up date written beside them, so missed collection callbacks stop hiding in the week.
Give one staff role one notebook page for dealer payment follow ups at a fixed daily time, so callbacks happen even on dispatch days.

problems.words: Electricity bill is the biggest cost after resin
quick_ideas: Note which machines run idle between jobs for a few days
Write down power cut hours and parts lost mid-cycle

workzap_build.text: A daily view of output against downtime and idle hours per machine.

problems.ask_first: Is power wasted mostly by idle machines, or by power cuts?
problems.free_stops: How power cost is spread per machine and piece is detailed in the solution document; for tariff questions, talk to your utility or adviser.

extra_ideas.text: Note which machines stay heated without producing during changeovers this week, so avoidable power waste is easier to spot.
Give one shift lead the job of noting idle heated machines in one notebook, so wasted running time gets reviewed daily.

problems.words: No catalogue for dealers; they ask on WhatsApp every time
quick_ideas: Photograph your full range once with item codes
Keep the photos in one folder ready to share

workzap_build.text: A WhatsApp catalogue for dealers with item photos and current availability.

problems.ask_first: Do dealers ask on WhatsApp mostly for photos, or for prices?
problems.free_stops: How the catalogue stays in sync with stock is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count which item photos and item codes dealers ask for most in one week, so the missing range is clear.
Give one staff member the job of keeping all item photos and codes in one shared folder, so dealer replies go faster.

never_say: Any advice on food-contact, medical-grade or child-safe compliance, additives or formulations.
Any help labelling recycled material as virgin or misrepresenting grade.
Any guidance on plastic bans, environmental rules or how to avoid them.
Accusations against individual operators; note the record gap only.
Electrical or machine safety advice; burns and crush injuries are emergencies.

sample_reply.person: Dana ka rate har hafte badalta hai aur dealers ko purane rate pe maal ja raha hai. Kya karein?
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, iska hal mumkin hai aur isi hafte shuruaat ho sakti hai. 1) Apne main items ka per piece cost aaj ke resin rate pe ek dafa nikaal lein, taa ke pata chale kaun se item ab ghaate pe ja rahe hain. 2) Us cost ko dealers ki mojooda rate list ke saath rakh kar dekh lein. Workzap yeh kaam aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: per piece cost calculator jo resin rate badalte hi update ho, aur dealers ki rate list bhi uske saath apne aap tayyar ho. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
